output.content: I checked the deployment logs for the last three weekly model retraining cycles. Every run pushed the new forecast binary to all store nodes simultaneously. There is no flag to route a percentage of traffic to a shadow instance, and no mechanism to split store groups for comparative evaluation. The pipeline moves from build to production in a single atomic step. I observed no intermediate state where a subset of stores received the updated logic while others retained the previous version. The process simply swaps the active model version across the entire cluster at the scheduled maintenance window.
output.reclassify_reason: The text is a purely observational report of the current deployment architecture and logs, containing no expressed wishes, refusals, or stated needs.
